title: Racial Inequality and Bureaucracy in U.S. Manufacturing
eligible_reason: No staggered adoption design. Main regressions (Table 3) are worker-firm-year earnings regressions: log earnings on Black, structured management (SM), union (UN) and Black x SM, Black x UN with survey-year FE, weights and firm-clustered SEs, plus AKM worker-FE decompositions and hiring/exit selection analyses. Treatments are time-invariant or cross-sectional workplace attributes; no post x treated switching at unit-specific dates. The 'two-way fixed effects' hit refers to the AKM worker and firm effects.
design_notes: Replication_Code_MOPS.R Part A (synthetic mode): lm(e ~ black*SM + black*UN + controls + factor(year), weights). Part B (archival): feols(e ~ black + SM + UN + BS + BU | earnings_year, cluster firm) and feols(e ~ age402 + age403 | pik + fx + year) AKM decomposition on restricted LEHD data.
estimators_reported: weighted OLS with year FE and interactions
AKM two-way (worker and firm) fixed-effects decomposition
data_files_note: README: restricted Census/LEHD/MOPS data in the FSRDC; package ships 'realistic synthetic stand-ins' that 'will not reproduce the published estimates'.
software_notes: R (data.table, base lm; archival code uses fixest::feols).
priority_note: Not a DiD design; synthetic data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
